<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Low-Poly 3D Humanoid Animation</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        #canvas {
            display: block;
        }
    </style>
    <script type="importmap">
        {
            "imports": {
                "three": "./three.module.js"
            }
        }
    </script>
</head>

<body>
    <script type="module">
        import * as THREE from './three.module.js';

        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x0000ff });
        const humanoid = new THREE.Group();
        humanoid.add(new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material));
        scene.add(humanoid);

        const treadmill = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(10, 0.1, 5), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x888888 }));
        treadmill.position.y = -1;
        scene.add(treadmill);

        camera.position.z = 5;

        const clock = new THREE.Clock();
        const duration = 10;
        const standDuration = 2;
        const walkDuration = 3;
        const runDuration = 3;

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            const elapsed = clock.getElapsedTime() % duration;
            const cycle = Math.floor(elapsed / duration);

            if (elapsed < standDuration) {
                // Stand still
                humanoid.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
                humanoid.position.set(0, 0, 0);
            } else if (elapsed < standDuration + walkDuration) {
                // Walk in place
                humanoid.rotation.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 2) * 0.2;
                humanoid.rotation.z = Math.cos(elapsed * 2) * 0.1;
                humanoid.position.set(0, Math.sin(elapsed * 4) * 0.1, 0);
            } else if (elapsed < standDuration + walkDuration + runDuration) {
                // Run in place
                humanoid.rotation.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 4) * 0.4;
                humanoid.rotation.z = Math.cos(elapsed * 4) * 0.2;
                humanoid.position.set(0, Math.sin(elapsed * 8) * 0.2, -0.2);
            } else {
                // Stand still again
                humanoid.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
                humanoid.position.set(0, 0, 0);
            }

            treadmill.position.z -= 0.05;
            if (treadmill.position.z < -5) treadmill.position.z = 0;

            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        animate();

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>

</html>
